title: On the Fourier Mean Bodies of a Convex Body
summary: In 1998, R. Gardner and G. Zhang introduced the radial $p$th mean bodies $R_pK$ of a convex body $K\subset\mathbb R^n$, $p>-1$, which have since become important objects in geometric tomography. In this paper we study the Fourier transforms of the radial functions of $R_pK$. This leads to a new family of star-shaped sets $F_pK$, which we call the Fourier $p$th mean bodies of $K$. We prove Fourier inversion formulas connecting $R_pK$ and $F_pK$, realizing them as $p$-intersection bodies in the sense of A. Koldobsky.
